title: Getting in the Door: Streamlining Intake in Civil Legal Services with Large Language Models

live_model.evidence: Model list: "gpt-4o-2024-08-06, gpt-4-0613, gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09, gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18"; Table 4 row "GPT-4-turbo...0.86 0.81 0.82" (weighted P/R/F1).

prompt.location: Sec. 3-4; "the full code and prompt are available on GitHub in two repositories"
prompt.note: Eligibility-screening prompt built from jurisdiction intake rules plus a tenant scenario; prompt intentionally omits worked examples.

claim.location: Table 4 (segmented by jurisdiction), Weighted average F1 column

data.source: 48 scenario-jurisdiction pairs (dataset D1); "dataset and code to reproduce this experiment is available" (GitHub)

notes: GPT-4-turbo is the best-performing of 8 tested models overall (384 = 48 x 8 total results) and was also used to iteratively refine the prompt itself. A separate 11-transcript expert-attorney review (dataset D2) is qualitative, not used for this record's claim.
